capabilities: Build citation-graph canvases from Zotero collections, tags, DOIs or arXiv IDs
Expand papers with references and citing works filtered by year and keyword
Group papers into tagged, overlapping clusters and track reading status
Download arXiv PDFs or link Zotero-stored PDFs from paper notes
Summarize papers and get paper recommendations from an LLM
extras: Free, no telemetry; desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. LLM summaries and recommendations bill your LLM account or Claude subscription; the full guide, changelog and contributing docs live outside the README. A guide warns to keep downloaded PDFs out of git or Obsidian Sync via .gitignore or excluded folders.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to lay out papers as a citation graph on a canvas or pull and grow a literature collection from a reference manager.

relations.evidence: Build a canvas from a Zotero collection or tag, or add papers one at a time by DOI or arXiv ID.
Faster citation lookups | A free Semantic Scholar API key. Without one, a large collection takes minutes

requires.name: Anthropic, OpenAI or Google Gemini API key
Zotero API key and user ID for syncing

summary: Canvas-based literature graph builder that turns Zotero collections or DOIs into citation graphs with reference expansion, PDFs and LLM summaries.
